payload.title: Wire the concept directives to the knowledge index in static builds
payload.description:
As a publication builder, I want recent-concepts, concept-list and concept-count to render real data in static sites, so that wiki directives are not empty placeholders.

```gherkin
Feature: Concept directives in static builds
  Scenario: Render from the index
    Given a knowledge index JSON file
    When a page uses concept-count
    Then the number of accepted entities is rendered in the page
```
